title: Distributed Error Handling State Machine for Balanced Search Structures in Chronos-Compute
topic: The Distributed Systems Error Handling Handbook

abstract: Distributed systems frequently encounter transient failures that must be handled without compromising data consistency or system availability. This work presents a lightweight error handling framework that couples a circuit-breaker state machine with an exponential-backoff retry policy, embedded within a balanced search tree implementation. The framework preserves the strict height-balance and key-ordered invariants of the tree while guaranteeing that point and range queries remain $O(\log N)$ and that node insertions and rebalancings also execute in $O(\log N)$. Formal proofs establish that the circuit-breaker transitions do not violate the tree invariants, and static AST analysis confirms the absence of unchecked exceptions. The source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Chronos-Compute-enterprise-patterns/tree/main/algorithms/20261110_110115_the_distributed_systems_error}.
